task: Welcome to another life changing session of TextWorld! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to go south. After that, pick up the American style passkey from the floor of the pantry. If you can get your hands on the American style passkey, unlock the American style portal in the pantry. And then, make absolutely sure that the American style portal within the pantry is open. And then, head south. With that done, venture west. Okay, and then, go to the south. That done, make an effort to venture south. And then, lift the key from the floor of the garage. That's it!
description:
Guess what, you are in a place we're calling a laundry place.

You make out a locked basket.

There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

thought: I'll go south as the first step.
feedback:
You find yourself in a pantry. An usual kind of place.

You can see a locker. The locker is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever! You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a table. Now why would someone leave that there? The table is typical. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. You smell a wretched smell, and follow it to a rack. But the thing is empty.

There is a closed American style portal leading south. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

There is an American style passkey on the floor.
